name: api_projects_create
_description: POST /api/v1/projects/create - Crea cliente (si no existe) + proyecto multi-tenant. Dispara el orchestrator. Reemplaza al webhook publico /new-project con la version autenticada.

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::uuid AS tenant_id,
         $2::text AS client_name,
         NULLIF($3::text, '') AS client_email,
         NULLIF($4::text, '') AS client_phone
),
found AS (
  SELECT c.id
  FROM clients c, input i
  WHERE c.tenant_id = i.tenant_id
    AND i.client_email IS NOT NULL
    AND c.email = i.client_email
  LIMIT 1
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO clients (tenant_id, name, email, phone)
  SELECT i.tenant_id, i.client_name, i.client_email, i.client_phone
  FROM input i
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM found)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT id FROM found UNION ALL SELECT id FROM ins LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO projects (
  tenant_id, client_id, name, project_type,
  budget_target, budget_flexible,
  location_address, location_city, location_province,
  property_type, property_area_m2, urgency,
  current_phase, status, metadata
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3, $4,
  $5::numeric, $6::boolean,
  $7, $8, $9,
  $10, $11::numeric, $12,
  'intake', 'active', $13::jsonb
) RETURNING id, name, current_phase, created_at
